The §6Entropy Manipulator§f is AE2's powered multi-tool. Right-click to rotate blocks, sneak-right-click to dismantle them, and use it on a §6Security Terminal§f to cycle permissions.

Crafted from a §6Fluix Crystal§f, §6ME Energy Cell§f, §6Engineering Processor§f, and §b3 Iron Ingots§f. It holds §b200,000 AE§f internally and costs §b1,600 AE§f per right-click (sneak-right-click is free).

Heat and cool mode: right-click to heat blocks (turns water to ice, grass to dirt) or sneak-right-click to cool them (turns lava to obsidian, grass to dirt). This makes it useful beyond just AE2 maintenance.

§cWARNING:§f Dismantling a §6Controller§f or §6Quantum Ring§f will destroy the multiblock structure. Charge it in a §6Charger§f between uses.
